proof_body:
by
  intro m k m' k' x₀ y₀ h₁ h₂
  have e₁ : ∀ x : ℝ, m * x + k - y₀ = m * (x - x₀) := by intro x; rw [h₁]; ring
  have e₂ : ∀ x : ℝ, m' * x + k' - y₀ = m' * (x - x₀) := by intro x; rw [h₂]; ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := h (x₀ + 1) (x₀ + 1)
    rw [e₁, e₂] at this
    linear_combination this
  · intro h x₁ x₂
    rw [e₁, e₂]
    linear_combination (x₁ - x₀) * (x₂ - x₀) * h
target_source: ∀ (m k m' k' x₀ y₀ : ℝ), y₀ = m * x₀ + k → y₀ = m' * x₀ + k' → ((∀ x₁ x₂ : ℝ, (x₁ - x₀) * (x₂ - x₀) + (m * x₁ + k - y₀) * (m' * x₂ + k' - y₀) = 0) ↔ m * m' = -1)
